File roofing permits and inspection forms online
A roofing contractor had Grok Bot fill out and pull a permit, book an inspection through a captcha-protected form, and email two job-notification forms to his insurer.
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
Price Foulger, a roofing contractor, gave Grok Bot his office paperwork over two days. It filled out and pulled an online roofing permit. It also booked a roof inspection through an online form with a captcha, and emailed two job-notification forms to his insurance company. The post doesn't describe the setup or any human steps in between.
How it went
All three tasks were done within two days. They were part of a longer list of operations work. The post gives no failure details, timings or costs, and it doesn't say whether he reviewed anything.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Help me with permit paperwork for [job type] at [address] with [city or county permit portal]. Fill in the permit application, find the inspection booking form, and prepare the notification forms for [insurer or recipient] using these details: [job details]. Pause and show me everything before you submit any form or send any email, and stop when each one has been submitted or sent with my approval.
Original source: https://grokbotpulse.com/en/categories/email
